presentation.label: MIDI GENERATOR
presentation.summary: A looping shift register writes the notes of one MIDI track.
presentation.overview: In the style of the Music Thing Modular Turing Machine: a 16-step loop of bits advances once per trig of the selected MIDI track and lifts each trig 0 to 24 semitones above its own NOTE. TURING LOCK decides how often a bit flips as it comes round: 127 repeats the phrase, 64 is random.
highlights: One MIDI track, chosen in PROJECT > CONTROL > MIDI SEQUENCER
LOCK 127 freezes the current 16-note phrase; 64 lets it wander
Follows the track's own trigs, NOTE, chord notes, TRAN and note lengths
usage: Set TURING TRACK to a MIDI track with trigs, then play.
Turn TURING LOCK towards 127 to keep a phrase you like, towards 64 to let it change.

controls.name: TURING TRACK
controls.doc: MIDI track whose notes the register writes; OFF leaves every track stock

controls.name: TURING LOCK
controls.doc: Chance that a bit keeps its value as it loops: 127 never flips (the phrase repeats), 64 flips about half the time, 0 always flips (a 32-step phrase)

limitations: M1 prototype: one track at a time, a fixed 16-step loop, chromatic notes 0..24 semitones above each trig's NOTE.
Settings are battery-RAM bytes like CC DIRECT CONNECT: global, not saved with a project or Part. The register itself is runtime state.
The register starts from the same seed after every boot.
Not tested: arpeggiator, NOTE parameter locks, incoming MIDI notes, Part or pattern changes while playing, timing, hardware.

tests.summary: Emulator only: modules/turing-machine/verify.py drives the panel under the ColdFire port and reads MIDI OUT (15 checks). With TURING TRACK OFF, MIDI OUT matched stock byte for byte. Cycles, memory totals and hardware are not measured.

access.location: PROJECT > CONTROL > MIDI SEQUENCER: TURING TRACK and TURING LOCK, under CC DIRECT CONNECT.
steps: Press PROJ. Select CONTROL with UP/DOWN and press RIGHT.
Select MIDI SEQUENCER and press YES.
Select TURING TRACK with DOWN and press RIGHT, or turn LEVEL, to choose a MIDI track.
Select TURING LOCK and turn LEVEL: 127 repeats the phrase, 64 is random.
